The backend for LWJGL 2: its natives, its OpenGL and OpenAL bindings, its window bridge, its input forwarder, its native cursors and its snapshot backend.
Learn: [LWJGL 2 backend](/build/backends/lwjgl2/).

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`Lwjgl2AlBinding`](/reference/lwjgl2/lwjgl2albinding/) | class | The OpenAL binding of LWJGL 2, given to `AlAudioBridge` by the LWJGL 2 backend. |
| [`Lwjgl2Backend`](/reference/lwjgl2/lwjgl2backend/) | class | The backend for LWJGL 2, which draws with OpenGL into the `Display` and plays sound with the OpenAL of LWJGL 2. |
| [`Lwjgl2CoreGlFrameBufferBinding`](/reference/lwjgl2/lwjgl2coreglframebufferbinding/) | class | The LWJGL 2 framebuffer binding that calls the core framebuffer functions of OpenGL 3.0 and `GL_ARB_framebuffer_object`. |
| [`Lwjgl2ExtGlFrameBufferBinding`](/reference/lwjgl2/lwjgl2extglframebufferbinding/) | class | The LWJGL 2 framebuffer binding that calls the functions of `GL_EXT_framebuffer_object`. |
| [`Lwjgl2GlBinding`](/reference/lwjgl2/lwjgl2glbinding/) | class | The OpenGL binding of LWJGL 2, which calls the classes `GL11` to `GL33`. |
| [`Lwjgl2InputForwarder`](/reference/lwjgl2/lwjgl2inputforwarder/) | class | Reads the pending mouse and keyboard events of LWJGL 2 and forwards them to the UI bridges of JOID. |
| [`Lwjgl2Keys`](/reference/lwjgl2/lwjgl2keys/) | class | Maps the key codes of LWJGL 2 to the keys of JOID, by physical position or through the character that the key typed. |
| [`Lwjgl2Natives`](/reference/lwjgl2/lwjgl2natives/) | class | Extracts the native libraries of LWJGL 2 and OpenAL into the cache folder, unless the application already provides them. |
| [`Lwjgl2SnapshotBackend`](/reference/lwjgl2/lwjgl2snapshotbackend/) | class | The snapshot backend of LWJGL 2, which renders in an offscreen OpenGL context. |
| [`Lwjgl2WindowBridge`](/reference/lwjgl2/lwjgl2windowbridge/) | class | The window bridge of the `Display` of LWJGL 2, in screen pixels, with the clipboard of AWT and native cursors. |
| [`MacNativeCursor`](/reference/lwjgl2/macnativecursor/) | class | The native cursors of macOS, read from `NSCursor`. |
| [`NativeCursor`](/reference/lwjgl2/nativecursor/) | class | Sets the system cursors that LWJGL 2 cannot set by itself, through JNA and the native cursor of LWJGL 2. |
| [`WindowsNativeCursor`](/reference/lwjgl2/windowsnativecursor/) | class | The native cursors of Windows, loaded with `LoadCursorW`. |
| [`X11NativeCursor`](/reference/lwjgl2/x11nativecursor/) | class | The native cursors of X11, from the cursor theme of libXcursor or else from the cursor font. |
